text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting the approval of amendments to the parking regulations on the south side of Tom Wells Crescent, between a point 91 metres north of Sanwood Boulevard (west intersection) and a point 49 metres further east. The proposed amendment will change the timing of existing parking prohibition, currently in effect from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m., to be in effect at all times. The proposed amendments will enhance safety and facilitate easier vehicle movements for residents exiting their driveways on this section of the street. During the course of the investigation, Transportation Services identified a bylaw adopted in 2013 containing an entry error. Recommendation 6 in this report rescinds this bylaw.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. on both sides of Tom Wells Crescent, between Sanwood Boulevard (west intersection) and Sanwood Boulevard (east intersection). 2. Prohibited parking from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. on the east, north, and west side of Tom Wells Crescent, between Sanwood Boulevard (east intersection) and Sanwood Boulevard (west intersection). 3. Prohibited parking from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. on the east side of Tom Wells Crescent, between Sanwood Boulevard (west intersection) and a point 91 metres north. 4. Prohibited parking from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. on the west side of Tom Wells Crescent, between Sanwood Boulevard (east intersection) and a point 100 metres north. 5.
